item.environment: latest Zeppelin master, Spark 1.4.0, Hadoop 2.4.0, a Mesos cluster with executors running spark-1.4.0-bin-hadoop2.4.tgz

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
GitHub user jersub opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/incubator-zeppelin/pull/105

Fix the jets3t dependency according to the Hadoop version

Fixes S3 support for Hadoop >= 2.3 (ZEPPELIN-111 https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/ZEPPELIN-111)

Regression from PR #88.

You can merge this pull request into a Git repository by running:

$ git pull https://github.com/biometis/incubator-zeppelin fix-jets3t

Alternatively you can review and apply these changes as the patch at:

https://github.com/apache/incubator-zeppelin/pull/105.patch

To close this pull request, make a commit to your master/trunk branch
with (at least) the following in the commit message:

This closes #105
